subject: The 6 PM treat that adds 200 calories
preview_text: We analyzed 10,000 dogs and found one habit that secretly packs on pounds. See what it is.
body_paragraphs: We crunched the numbers on 10,000 dogs in PupShape. The result? A single habit—the 6 PM treat—adds an average of 200 hidden calories per day. That's like feeding your dog a small cheeseburger every evening. And most owners don't even realize it.

Here's the shocker: those 'healthy' store-bought treats are often loaded with sugar and filler. Over 8 weeks, that 200-calorie habit alone can stall weight loss by 40%. But the good news? You can fix it without taking away the joy of treat time.

Open your PupShape app and check the 'Treat Tracker' feature. It's built to swap those calorie bombs for vet-approved alternatives that your dog will love—and that won't sabotage their progress. You'll see exactly how many calories each treat adds, with smart swaps that keep them happy.

Try this now: Open the app, tap 'Treat Tracker,' and log tonight's treat. You'll see the difference in seconds. P.S. Dogs who switched to low-cal treats lost 15% more weight in the same timeframe. Your pup deserves that edge.
